envelope.author: nico
envelope.reason: Stop the plan while correcting a shard that demands an unavailable native Claude enforcement seam.

payload.title: dispatch enforcement follows harness fidelity
payload.body: The bound dispatch-contract plan exposed that Claude native Agent calls provide no per-call machine-enforced response schema. The dispatch contract must be caller-owned on every harness, machine-enforced where the harness offers that seam, and projected at the highest available fidelity with an explicit shortfall where it does not; role defaults and invented transport remain excluded.
